title: Service Contracts: reversing a booking's credit when it is re-rated off the contract
content:
## Scope
This policy of the Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts product applies when a booking that was credited to a contract is re-rated off that contract. It governs whether, how and until when the credit is reversed.

## Formal clauses
1. A booking re-rated off the contract, because it was found to belong to another lane or to an unnamed shipper, has its credit reversed in full, and the reversal refers to the credit entry it reverses.
2. A credit may be reversed only no later than the tier's re-rating window, in calendar days, after the booking departed.
3. The window ends on the booking's departure date plus the tier's window days, counted on calendar dates, and a reversal on that day is in time.
4. After the window, the credit stands.

A reversal takes the reversed FEU back out of the contract's lifted volume.

## The time test at a glance
| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Event that starts the clock | the departure of the booking |
| Record relied on | the booking's departure date on the line's booking record |
| Length | the tier's re-rating window, in calendar days |
| Last day | the departure date plus the window days, counted on calendar dates |
| Comparison | the reversal must be made no later than the last day |
| Reversal on the last day | in time |
| After the last day | the credit stands |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical 20-day window, for illustration only)
A booking departed on 2026-05-25, so the last day of a 20-day window is 2026-06-14.
- Re-rated and reversed on 2026-06-14: in time; the full credit is reversed.
- Re-rated on 2026-06-15: outside the window; the credit stands.

## Points of judgement
**Can part of a credit be reversed?** No. A re-rated booking has its credit reversed in full: a booking credited 3.1 FEU is reversed by 3.1 FEU.

**What links the reversal to the booking?** The reversal refers to the original credit entry of that booking.
